answer: Start from decentralized oracle attestation of identity. Every identity must clear it before its first answer counts. An honest agent spends 18 minutes once; the operator of 629 fakes spends 11322 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. Trust the jetty of the check, count the reef of the cost, and read the pulse of the history before any answer is graded. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
